messages:
anya: Heads-up: ran into an edge case while testing sampling + routing. When `prefer-cost` routing falls back to Dedicated we still log request traces, but sampling logic seems to run twice (hosted + dedicated). We might be double-counting sensitive payloads. anyone seen this?
kevin: hmm, interesting. do you have a repro or example trace id?
anya: repro attached in the test org, trace 1738001122, flow: hosted -> capacity-exhausted -> dedicated-fallback. sampling_pct=10 on hosted, 100 on dedicated (for debug). result: both systems kept a copy (hosted sampled + dedicated full).
sam: that sounds like a policy composition bug. current model: each layer enforces its own sampler independently. expected: sampler should be applied at ingress only, unless an explicit inspect/breakglass flag is set.
kevin: agree. two options: 1) make sampling decisions sticky (generate sampling_key at ingress and pass down), or 2) make downstream samplers detect and respect upstream headers like `X-Redwood-Sample: chosen,reason=ingress`.
anya: I prefer sticky sampling. easier to reason about audits and billing. sticky key = `sha256(customer_id + route + salt)` then `%100 < pct`.
sam: sticky is fine but watch PII: customer_id can be email. we must not log the raw key inputs. store only `sample_key_hash` (HMAC with rotation) and reason tag.
kevin: implementation sketch (js):
```js
// at ingress
const key = `${customerId}|${route}`
const sampleHash = hmacSHA256(SAMPLER_KEY, key)
const samplePct = config(route).samplePct || 0
const chosen = Number(sampleHash.slice(0,8),16) % 100 < samplePct
res.setHeader('X-Redwood-Sample', JSON.stringify({v:1,h:sampleHash.slice(0,8),pct:samplePct,src:'ingress'}))
```
ki-bot: ci-bot: smoke-tests for sampler-sticky branch passed in staging :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build 4521 succeeded, tests 14/14
sam: re: PII redaction levels — we need three distinct tiers for console telemetry: `mask` (replace characters), `hash` (HMAC short token), `audit-only` (full payload stored encrypted, accessible only via special audit flow with approvals).
anya: console UX: default view should show `mask` results with option to request audit (adds `audit-requested` event). audit flow = email approval + 2FA + ops-bot gate.
kevin: technical constraints: `audit-only` requires encrypted blob in our audit KMS with TTL and strict access logs. also add retention meta (reason, approver, ticket id).
sam: one more: sampling determinism across routing policy variants. if route changes (e.g., `prefer-fast` -> `prefer-cost`) we should bind `route_group` rather than exact route name so moving between variants preserves sample decision for the request family.
anya: good call. propose `sample_key = hmac(customerId + route_group)` and route_group derived from policy mappings. reduces churn on rollout.
kevin: will draft PR to: 1) add `X-Redwood-Sample` header, 2) sticky sampler impl in edge-proxy, 3) console flags for mask/hash/audit-only, 4) telemetry tag `sample_origin` and `sample_reason`.
anya: ops-canary: ops-bot can we schedule a canary? start with 5% of orgs, audit-only off, mask default.
ops-bot: scheduled canary 2024-09-12 09:00 UTC -> 5% orgs, rollback auto at +10% error increase or latency +50ms. :eyes:
kevin: awesome. I'll include migration notes for existing logs (backfill policy: mark previously logged items as `pre-sticky-sampler`).
anya: thanks all — i'll open a tracking RFC and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
